semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: 'Fact recall in language models' directly pertains to the capacity and behavior of language models, making 'language models' a semantically equivalent domain.
Fact recall is a part of the broader domain of language modeling as it involves dealing with how well a model can remember and recall factual information.

parent_domains.justification: Language modeling is a broader domain that encompasses all tasks related to training and evaluating language models, including fact recall.
This is the broader category under which fact recall, as a specific task related to language models, falls.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Language modeling is the closest parent domain as it directly correlates with the aspect of modeling the ability to recall facts, a foundational task for language models.

child_domains.justification: Fact recall is a specific aspect of evaluating a language model's performance, thus falling under the domain of language model evaluation.

closest_child_domain.justification: Evaluating a model's ability to recall facts is a direct aspect of language model evaluation, making it the closest match.

sibling_domains.justification: Pre-training is a related area under language modeling and involves preparation crucial for tasks like fact recall.
Training involves all aspects including fact recall, making it a sibling domain.
Scaling influences how well models can retain and recall factual information, relating it to fact recall.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Training specifically involves the processes that enable models to develop capabilities like fact recall, making it very similar.

unrelated_domains.justification: Vision-language models pertain to tasks involving vision data, which is separate from the focus on language models and fact recall.
Natural language inference deals with understanding and inferring meanings rather than recalling facts.
This domain focuses on analyzing bias rather than the capability to recall facts.
Detoxification involves filtering content, which is unrelated to fact recall.
While it might seem related, self-improvement focuses on model self-updates rather than mere fact recall.

domain_pool: multilingual datasets and large language models
